text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now, mow them down! Sword of the Heavens, 
Sacred Light of Morienne Ange!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: This presence...! I'll outrun it!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Kh... I won't let you!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's legs rev up once more. 
Like the wheels of a freshly fueled steam 
engine, she charges forward, rattling the 
ground violently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her legs are visibly failing to lift. Even 
so, she continues to gallop at high speed, 
striving to move forward even a fraction 
of an inch.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I can still, still, still, still keep 
going! Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single streak of lightning pierced 
through before the goal post.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As if marking the remnants of the light, 
the trail of a black tail was seared 
behind my eyelids..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Calstone Light O! Calstone 
Light O goes wire-to-wire—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah......... I've arrived. The 
scenery at maximum speed...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Within the light, total silence. 
Everything vanished, and I became part of 
the light.)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Footsteps echoing from far in the 
distance.)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We're still mid-journey. The end of the 
light— top speed lies further beyond this 
point.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep chasing. For as long as... I 
keep running.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
They managed to run all the way to the 
end, huh.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"To think not even my holy sword could cut 
through it. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"If it's light, then there was nothing to 
be done. You pierced right through at the 
speed of light."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Did I appear that way to you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Reaching that level is no simple 
feat. ...I am truly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'll go polish my blade and start anew. 
Next time, I'll be sharp enough to cut 
through light itself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It is a complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You did a fine job. ...You were truly 
fast.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the highest compliment I 
could receive.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Next, I shall demonstrate my deeds. Until 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, speed really is great, isn't it! 
Right O-san was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right, Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Any Umamusume's blood would boil 
at the sight. Pure, unadulterated speed 
stirs our very instincts.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your Bakushin itch was acting up too, 
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... This is why speed freaks are 
such a handful. Did they sniff me out by 
scent?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh, precisely! For Daitaku Helios 
has shown us so brilliantly: the infinite 
potential of an Umamusume's physical form!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The impact of the placebo effect was 
particularly intriguing. It not only 
served as a trigger to break through 
limits, but seemed to deceive the physical 
body itself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Her primal instincts and fierce 
motivation synergized, temporarily 
rendering her limits entirely void. That 
glitch even extended to her self-healing 
capacity..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Why on earth did I ever think I 
had everything figured out?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume body is still full of 
mysteries! It holds so very much 
potential!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand complicated 
things, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I think it'd be great if you just Bakushin 
in your own Tachyon-like way!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Here with us is Calstone Light O, the 
winner of the Sprinters Stakes! Tell us 
how you feel right now!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's the best! I'm in the best mood ever! 
I'm so happy I want to dance the samba, 
though my fatigue level won't let me, so I 
won't!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're not going to dance...? Looking 
back at today's race, what do you think 
was the key to your victory?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know! Running fast is the only 
thing on my mind, after all.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, were there any specific 
measures or training routines you focused 
on?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I ran with a cheetah in VR.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: A, a cheetah? Like, the animal?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My life was threatened several times, 
giving me quite a chill. Curse you, 
Durendal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Me!? I don't know anything, I'm innocent!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm, and now, a message for all your 
fans!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To reach top speed—that was my dream. 
Aiming beyond the speed of light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Today, I reached that view. Yet, it was 
not the final destination.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. Top speed is made to be 
broken. There is no finish line."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: And so, the path I tread is also eternal!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I will keep pursuing it! Speed, that is!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We're counting on you!! Set a record so 
fast that no one will ever break it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone can get even faster! Show us 
your next top speed!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The jubilant cheers of the spectators 
still echoed without end. With all that 
uproar at her back, she appeared here.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's cheerful voice echoes. 
A faint smile is visible on her lips.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the most fulfilled expression she 
had ever worn.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How was my running?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From start to finish. There is so much I 
want to touch upon and feel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, to put it in a single word...
choice_data_list:
That was your fastest yet! That was top 
speed!

That was your fastest yet! That was your 
top speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I, too, was able to reach beyond top 
speed— beyond the speed of light!
choice_data_list:
Still, you want to run even faster, don't 
you?
Still, you want to run even faster, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. More, more! So, please keep up the 
good work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pursuing top speed with no finish line in 
sight. I will keep moving forward with her 
from here on out—
